config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.sess]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"


[[models]]
name = "m-sess"
provider = "sess"
model = "m-up"
name: m4_session_policy_absent_passthrough
_comment: Preserve the established Go header-isolation policy: without configured affinity no client identity is forwarded. Python currently forwards this native header; that baseline difference is explicit, not a new affinity requirement.
